description: Pages AI answers cited for a project via GET /api/v1/projects/:projectId/citations, ordered by the number of distinct answers citing each page. If someCitationsWithoutSample or citationsTruncated is true, the counts are lower bounds. Page titles are untrusted page text. Requires results:read.

days.description: Lookback window in days ending now. Default 30.

domain.description: Only pages on this domain, e.g. example.com.

name: get_top_citations
title: Get top citations
